scope: Independent bounded offline prototype/source-policy/security review; no external API or runtime promotion.

sourcePolicy.basis: Previously independently read exact Q4.a.ii scheme PDF7 and current1.26 PDF19; source contract0.1.0 preserved.
sourcePolicy.review: Actual structured scorer preserves these bounded rules. Zero with incomplete/wrong terms and wrong/blank final is appropriate within the explicit transcription contract; no natural-language recognition is claimed.

chemistryAndGeneration.review: Atom counts and sums correct. Unsigned32-bit seed repeats modulo10; no1000-unique-question claim. Public projection contains prompt/formula/Ar/marks, no private solution. Deep freezing protects constructed packages; validator checks consistency, not authenticity or live eligibility.

testRun.observations: 1000 seeded packages test ten unique public questions;80 authored synthetic cases test50 scored and30 deferred outcomes. Transport is stubbed for provider evaluation; no API credential used or inspected.

hiddenGoldReview.review: Provider receives hashed identifiers, public question and submitted response only; private expected labels remain local. Correct learner responses naturally contain an answer and are not gold-label leakage. Evaluation checks exact ID set, completion status, JSON schema, integer scores and null abstentions; malformed results count invalid rather than passing review. Synthetic gold is authored from source policy, not examiner-labelled evidence.

networkAndSecrets.review: Explicit --execute gate; dry-run sends zero requests. Fixed HTTPS endpoint, disabled redirects, environment-only key with validation, redacted transport errors, no retries after transport/auth failure. Maximum two requests/eight cases each, response size cap and30s timeout. Output constrained to a new resolved path below work/. No activation path.
networkAndSecrets.limits: Dataset origin marker is a self-declaration, not proof of provenance; nested publicQuestion/response fields are not deeply allowlisted. Safe for the locally generated fixture dataset inspected, not authorised for arbitrary student/source payloads. Model-version/latest documentation claim was not independently checked because this review prohibited external calls.

nonblockingFindings.detail: packets selects first16 cases: with current ordering this covers only n1/n2 and eight response patterns each. A later provider result must report16/80 and two formula variants, never coverage of all10. No shuffle/offset currently available.

Provider POLICY names unsupported notation but does not specify the exact local numeric regex or structured integer bounds. Current eight patterns are clear; future scientific-notation/oversized/malformed cases need explicit agreement criteria before interpreting provider disagreements as marking errors.

v0.2.0 validation.status remains not-run although synthetic tests have run. This is conservative rather than an overclaim, but distinguish synthetic run completed from calibration/activation not run when presenting status.

Synthetic cases closely mirror implementation branches and exercise only a finite related family. Passing them does not establish free-text/handwriting recognition, source difficulty equivalence, student layout quality or examiner calibration.

activationBlockersRemain: No empirical response or difficulty calibration.
